subtitles.en: Now when you bought the New York Liberty, you personally got involved in helping the turn of the team around.
subtitles.zh: 当你买下纽约自由人队后，你亲自参与帮助球队扭转局面。

subtitles.en: What were the steps you took to really enhance the team? People do ask what were the moves we made to improve the team and to take it to a championship
subtitles.zh: 你采取了哪些步骤来真正提升球队？人们常问我们做了哪些举措来改进球队并把它带到冠军水平。

subtitles.en: level because it happened pretty quickly, like within five years we won a championship.
subtitles.zh: 因为这发生得相当快，大约五年内我们就赢得了冠军。

subtitles.en: The most important and first move that we made was to move the team from Westchester County Center to Barkley Center.
subtitles.zh: 我们做出的最重要也是第一步的举措是将球队从威彻斯特县中心搬到巴克莱中心。

subtitles.en: After that, we started to invest and we invested in player health and performance.
subtitles.zh: 之后，我们开始投入，我们投入于球员健康和表现。

subtitles.en: We invested in management talent and we invested in facilities.
subtitles.zh: 我们投入于管理人才，我们投入于设施。

subtitles.en: Then we recruited a team that could compete and that started with recruiting the top free agent in 2023, Brianna Stewart.
subtitles.zh: 然后我们招募了一支有竞争力的球队，这始于2023年招募顶级自由球员布里安娜·斯图尔特。

subtitles.en: And at the same time that this was happening, the marketing team was busy thinking about the fan experience.
subtitles.zh: 与此同时，营销团队正忙于思考球迷体验。

subtitles.en: And so we built an experience in the arena that was frankly rooted in the culture of Brooklyn.
subtitles.zh: 因此我们在球馆内打造了一种体验，坦率地说，它植根于布鲁克林的文化。

subtitles.en: So all of the fan experience and the music and the dance and the art around what goes on in the fan experience was really Brooklyn related since Brooklyn is so artsy, you know
subtitles.zh: 所以所有的球迷体验、音乐、舞蹈和艺术都真正与布鲁克林相关，因为布鲁克林如此艺术化，你知道。

subtitles.en: it naturally sort of had a cool factor.
You put a lot of time and energy into it. You got to know the players pretty well and you won a championship.
subtitles.zh: 你投入了大量时间和精力，对球员们相当了解，还赢得了冠军。
en_highlights: a lot of time and energy

subtitles.en: So what was it like winning a championship? I think a joy that makes any other business success that I've had, you know, pale in
subtitles.zh: 那么赢得冠军是什么感觉？我觉得那种喜悦让我在商业上取得的任何成功都相形见绌。

winning_patterns: 机构/人物权威 + 具体数字/资产 + 强问题，例如 高盛王逸：4-5万亿城市更新会拖住楼市吗
大机构/名人 + 被逼/陷阱/真相/转向 等张力词，例如 野村辜朝明：日本央行被逼到墙角
具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
反常识判断 + 下一步条件，例如 低估值可能是价值陷阱，需等待政策转向消费
中国相关议题更容易获得点击，但表达要落在政策、需求、信心、估值、产业升级这些正向框架

avoid_patterns: 过长的新闻句，尤其是 24 字以上还塞多个从句
